description_good_justification: The README and the documentation site open with what pollen does: deploy Agent Skills and agent definitions declared in a pollen.yaml. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/README.md https://groupbees.github.io/pollen/
interact_justification: The installation guide says how to obtain pollen, and CONTRIBUTING.md how to report a bug in GitHub issues and how to contribute. https://groupbees.github.io/pollen/guides/installation/ https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_justification: Changes go through GitHub pull requests, as CONTRIBUTING.md describes under Submitting a change. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md sets the requirements: the code style the pre-commit hooks enforce, green tests, tests with every change, and documentation in the same pull request. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
documentation_basics_justification: The documentation site covers installing, a first run, every command, and authentication and pinning for well-known sources. https://groupbees.github.io/pollen/guides/installation/ https://groupbees.github.io/pollen/guides/usage/ https://groupbees.github.io/pollen/guides/well-known-sources/
documentation_interface_justification: The reference documents the configuration file, backed by a JSON Schema, and every environment variable with the flag it stands for; the Python guide documents the bindings. https://groupbees.github.io/pollen/reference/configuration/ https://groupbees.github.io/pollen/reference/environment-variables/ https://groupbees.github.io/pollen/guides/python/ https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/schema/pollen.schema.json
sites_https_justification: The site, the repository and the releases are served over HTTPS: https://groupbees.github.io/pollen/ https://github.com/groupbees/pollen https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/releases
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests: searchable, addressable by URL, open to anyone. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/issues https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/pulls
english_justification: The documentation, the code and the issue tracker are in English. https://groupbees.github.io/pollen/
repo_track_justification: Git records each change with its author and date. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/commits/main
repo_interim_justification: Every pull request is merged to main between releases. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/commits/main
version_unique_justification: Each release has its own version, set in Cargo.toml by scripts/release.sh and tagged. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/scripts/release.sh https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/releases
version_semver_justification: Releases follow Semantic Versioning, tagged vX.Y.Z. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/releases
version_tags_justification: Every release is a v* git tag, which the release workflow publishes from. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/tags https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yaml
release_notes_justification: Each GitHub release carries notes built from the merged pull requests, sorted into the sections of .github/release.yaml, not a git log. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/releases https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/.github/release.yaml
release_notes_vulns_justification: No vulnerability in pollen has been publicly disclosed. SECURITY.md commits a fix's release notes to cite its advisory and its CVE. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/security/advisories https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/SECURITY.md
report_process_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md sends bug reports to GitHub issues and says what to include. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
report_archive_justification: GitHub issues keep every report and response, searchable. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/issues?q=is%3Aissue
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: SECURITY.md sends reports to GitHub private vulnerability reporting, never a public issue. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/SECURITY.md
build_justification: cargo builds the CLI, maturin the Python bindings, both wrapped in Taskfile.yml. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/Taskfile.yml https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/Cargo.toml
build_floss_tools_justification: Every tool mise.toml pins is FLOSS: the Rust toolchain, Python, uv, Node.js, Task. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/mise.toml
test_justification: Rust unit and end-to-end tests, pytest tests of the bindings, and the documentation site's tests; CONTRIBUTING.md documents task test, and CI runs them. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/.github/workflows/quality.yaml
test_invocation_justification: cargo test for Rust, pytest for Python, both behind task test. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/Taskfile.yml
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: The quality workflow runs the tests on Linux and Windows on every pull request and push to main. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/.github/workflows/quality.yaml
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md: new behaviour comes with tests, and a fix with the regression test that would have caught it. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
tests_are_added_justification: The latest feature, deploying agent definitions, added Rust and Python tests with it. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/pull/103
warnings_justification: Clippy with the pedantic group on both crates, ruff and pyright on the Python package, Biome on the site, all in pre-commit. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/Cargo.toml https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml
warnings_fixed_justification: Clippy runs with -D warnings, and CI blocks a merge on any hook failure. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/.github/workflows/quality.yaml
warnings_strict_justification: Clippy's pedantic group with warnings denied, and unsafe code forbidden. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/Cargo.toml
crypto_published_justification: pollen checks downloads against SHA-256 digests and speaks TLS 1.2 and 1.3 through rustls with its default cipher suites; on Windows, through SChannel. Git sources go through the git command, which handles its own transport. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/pollen/src/source/well_known.rs https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/pollen/src/http.rs
crypto_call_justification: pollen implements no primitive: SHA-256 comes from the sha2 crate, TLS from rustls with the ring provider, or SChannel on Windows. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/pollen/Cargo.toml
crypto_floss_justification: sha2, rustls and ring are FLOSS; the Windows build uses SChannel, but the same functionality runs on rustls on every other platform. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/pollen/Cargo.toml
crypto_keylength_justification: rustls' defaults offer AES-128/256-GCM and ChaCha20-Poly1305 over X25519, P-256 and P-384, and its certificate verification rejects RSA keys under 2048 bits; nothing smaller can be enabled. On Windows, SChannel follows the system's TLS policy, where an administrator disables smaller keys. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/pollen/src/http.rs
crypto_working_justification: Digests are SHA-256 only: a pollen.yaml digest in any other algorithm is rejected. TLS uses rustls' defaults, which include no broken algorithm or mode. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/pollen/src/config/mod.rs https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/pollen/src/http.rs
crypto_pfs_justification: rustls only negotiates ephemeral (EC)DHE key exchange, in TLS 1.2 and 1.3. On Windows, SChannel follows the system's cipher suite policy. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/pollen/src/http.rs
crypto_password_storage_justification: pollen authenticates no user and stores no password: it reads tokens from the user's credentials file or helper command and sends them, never writing one. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/pollen/src/credentials.rs
crypto_random_justification: pollen generates no key or nonce itself; TLS session keys come from rustls with ring, which draws from the operating system's CSPRNG, or from SChannel on Windows. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/pollen/src/http.rs
delivery_mitm_justification: Releases ship over HTTPS from GitHub Releases, PyPI and the Homebrew tap, with Sigstore build provenance attestations. https://groupbees.github.io/pollen/guides/installation/
delivery_unsigned_justification: SHA256SUMS is served over HTTPS from GitHub Releases and carries a signed provenance attestation, as the installation guide shows. https://groupbees.github.io/pollen/guides/installation/
no_leaked_credentials_justification: The detect-private-key hook and Trivy's secret scanner run on every pull request, and CI uses only repository secrets and trusted publishing. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/.github/workflows/security.yaml
static_analysis_justification: Clippy, ruff, pyright, shellcheck and actionlint in pre-commit, Trivy's misconfiguration scanner, and GitHub CodeQL on Rust, Python and the workflows, on every pull request. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/.github/workflows/security.yaml https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL's default security queries for Rust, Python and GitHub Actions. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
static_analysis_often_justification: The pre-commit hooks and CodeQL run on every pull request and push to main, Trivy daily as well. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/.github/workflows/quality.yaml https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/.github/workflows/security.yaml
dynamic_analysis_justification: No fuzzer runs, and the coverage measured is lines and regions, not branches. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: pollen is written in Rust with unsafe code forbidden, and Python. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/Cargo.toml
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: cargo test builds the test profile, with debug assertions and integer overflow checks on. https://github.com/groupbees/pollen/blob/main/Taskfile.yml
